planner.language: Historical metrics control is disabled at All languages. Queries are English. Discovery was additionally checked with English selected.
planner.metric: Rounded ranges including close variants; no exact monthly totals or monthly history returned.
planner.growth: 3-month and year-on-year range indicators retained verbatim. +900% and +∞ are not precise sustained-growth forecasts.
planner.adCompetition: Advertiser competition only, not organic keyword difficulty.
planner.source: Original visible Google Ads Keyword Planner historical table; all 393 rows captured in the browser.
planner.export: CSV report did not produce a usable captured download; the table capture is the source, not an invented CSV export.

trends.index: Relative 0–100, independently normalized within each five-term comparison; not search volume.
trends.growth: Year-comparison calculated only on complete weekly observations. A usable classification requires at least 39 recent and 26 prior nonzero weeks and both mean indices >=1. Sparse comparisons remain limited; a larger comparison term can compress a smaller one.
trends.related: Provider Rising suggestions are stored in raw captures. Consumer, unrelated brand, machine-purchase and unsupported vehicle-fitment terms were excluded.

gsc.observed: 3-month view: processing data, check again in about a day

api.status: 403; one search-volume request failed; no metrics adopted

selection.policy: One intent per article. Twenty candidate queries/entities per article are research and coverage targets, not a list to repeat verbatim. High-volume umbrella terms support specific long-tail decisions. Preserve stable relevant demand. Do not label missing data as rising.
selection.reason: The observed market data does not substantiate 15–25 high-volume rising exact terms for every specialist article. Forcing that condition would introduce unrelated traffic or invented metrics.
